description: This file defines the BlobShellConfigurationSources class, which implements IShellConfigurationSources to manage shell configuration data stored in Azure Blob Storage, including methods for adding, saving, removing, and migrating configuration files.

classes.name: BlobShellConfigurationSources
classes.description: Implements shell configuration source management using Azure Blob Storage, providing methods to add, save, remove, and migrate configuration files.

methods.name: AddSourcesAsync
methods.description: Adds configuration sources for a specific tenant by retrieving configuration files from Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: SaveAsync
methods.description: Saves configuration data for a tenant into Azure Blob Storage, updating existing files or creating new ones.

methods.name: RemoveAsync
methods.description: Removes the configuration file for a specified tenant from Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: TryMigrateFromFileAsync
methods.description: Attempts to migrate configuration data from a local file to Azure Blob Storage for a tenant.
